breakdown.description: Gamma-centered k-point sampling conflicts with a half-shifted Monkhorst-Pack mesh.
breakdown.reason: The generated specification still includes a half-grid shift, stating 'for the bands calculation use the same grid with a half‑grid shift.' The ground truth resolves this conflict by removing the half-shift instruction entirely and specifying only a gamma-centered k-point grid. The generated output perpetuates the conflicting instruction by retaining the half-shift for the bands step, rather than eliminating it as the ground truth does.
